test_case.test_name: Parameterized authorized IOMMU-disabled AMD driver per-BDF binding validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the explicitly authorized IOMMU-disabled configuration is active across firmware, boot and runtime layers and amdgpu binds every expected GPU without DMA, driver, PCIe, xGMI or platform error.
required_package: Approved BIOS/kernel IOMMU-disabled policy and explicit DMA-isolation/security exception
Affirmative runtime oracle for disabled/bypass mode, not mere log absence
Approved configuration/reboot window, OOB access and rollback procedure
test_case.test_command: Capture current policy/cmdline/BDF state; after security and change approval, apply only the defined IOMMU-disabled configuration and reboot if authorized. Prove the intended firmware, cmdline and affirmative runtime disabled/bypass state, then verify loaded amdgpu version plus binding/PCIe/health for every expected BDF and capture complete DMA/driver logs.
test_case.expected_result: The exact approved disabled/bypass mode is affirmatively proven, all expected GPUs bind to amdgpu with expected PCIe visibility, and no DMA, amdgpu, XID, PCIe/xGMI, kernel or BMC fault appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires security authorization, consistent firmware/cmdline/runtime disabled-state evidence and complete per-BDF driver health. Missing IOMMU messages or global module presence alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Disabling translation changes the DMA trust boundary and requires explicit security approval.
BIOS/cmdline changes and reboot require OOB and rollback; do not alter unrelated settings.
Inventory GPU workloads/services before any boot or module change.
Abort on ambiguous mode, boot/access loss, missing BDF, binding failure or DMA/security fault; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Source Key/Variant ID and separate duplicate-row identity
Security exception and approved disabled-mode oracle
Pre/post BIOS/cmdline/boot identity and affirmative runtime state
test_case.recovery: On boot, mode or binding failure, preserve policy, bootloader, runtime, BDF and logs, then restore only the approved prior IOMMU configuration via OOB. Do not cycle modes or retry automatically.
